class.name: MaszynaLegacySignalHeadKindFactory
class.brief_description: Makes the kind of an original scenery signal head out of the [code]lights[/code] events aimed at it.
class.description: The original has no kinds of signal heads: what a signal head shows is whatever [code]lights[/code] events the scenery aims at its model ([code]Event.cpp:1741-1803[/code]), each one a list of [code]TAnimModel::LightSet()[/code] values. Every such event is made an aspect of the kind here, named after the event without the signal head's own name - [code](p1)_sem_ligh1[/code] aimed at [code](p1)[/code] is [code]sem_ligh1[/code] - so every copy of one include has the same kind.

method.name: create_kind
method.description: A kind of [param aspects]: aspect name to a [PackedFloat32Array] of the event's values.

method.name: get_aspect_name
method.description: The aspect the [code]lights[/code] event [param event_name] is for the signal head [param signal_head_name] it is aimed at.
